test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is/are logically implicit from the statement.

Statement: Romila got elected as the president of the student's committee of her school, so she must be senior.

Assumptions:

I. Only members of the student's committee can be seniors.

II. Only seniors can be the president of the student's committee.

III. Only girls can be the members of the student's committee.

options.text: Both assumptions I and II are implicit
Both assumption II and III are implicit

solution:
Given Statement: Romila got elected as the president of the student's committee of her school, so she must be senior.

Now, 

Assumptions:

1. Only members of the student's committee can be seniors - Not Implicit (The statement doesn't imply that only members of the student's committee can be seniors; it only suggests that Romila being a president implies she is a senior.)

2. Only seniors can be the president of the student's committee - Implicit (The statement suggests that being elected as president implies that Romila is a senior, indicating that only seniors can hold the position of president.)

3. Only girls can be the members of the student's committee - Not Implicit (The statement does not mention anything about the gender of the members of the student's committee.)

Here, Only assumption II is implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
